bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
candidate="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:gate-link-final-1cae702)" || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")" = "$candidate" || { echo FINAL_IMAGE_NOT_ACTIVE; exit 74; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
docker exec "$name" test -f /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs || exit 74
states="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='published')||'|'||COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state='needs_reconcile') FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting';")"
IFS='|' read -r published reconcile <<< "$states"
test "$published" -eq 2 && test "$reconcile" -eq 1 || { echo PANEL_STATE_CHANGED; exit 74; }
before="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||message_thread_id||'|'||message_id||'|'||state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id;")"
docker exec -e MENU_PUBLISH_PANEL_TYPES=posting -e GAYBBS_PUBLIC_MENU_RELEASE=enabled "$name" node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs > /tmp/gace-menu-gate-link-20261115.log 2>&1 || { echo PUBLISH_FAILED; sed -E 's#(https?://)[^[:space:]]+#\1[REDACTED]#g' /tmp/gace-menu-gate-link-20261115.log | tail -12; exit 1; }
after="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||message_thread_id||'|'||message_id||'|'||state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id;")"
test "$before" = "$after" || { echo PANEL_IDS_CHANGED; exit 1; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
echo PUBLISHED_MENU_UPDATED=2
echo SAME_MESSAGE_IDS=PASS
echo UNRECONCILED_PANEL_UNTOUCHED=PASS
echo DEPLOYED_FINAL_IMAGE="$candidate"
echo USERBOT_ACTIVE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
